name: BMP AI Technologies, Inc.
summary: BMP AI Technologies, Inc. specializes in providing sophisticated solutions for intelligent document processing. Their flagship offering is Multidoc.ai, an advanced artificial intelligence platform. This platform empowers enterprises and organizations to construct bespoke AI assistants, which are capable of resolving queries by efficiently extracting necessary information from vast collections of the client's archived documents and repositories. The company, founded in 2000, operates out of Bogota, Colombia. It is noteworthy that the entity, formerly known as Neuralbase AI Ltd., is scheduled to officially adopt the name BMP AI Technologies, Inc. in October 2025.
